module: Flowgraph node 'Ease' (simple category). Applies an easing function to the input value (normally between 0 and 1): linear, in/out/inOut for Quad, Cubic, Quart, Quint, Sin, Exp and Circ. The function is chosen in the node properties.
notes: The UI list (easeFuncNameList) does not include inCubic, outCubic, inOutCubic, although they are defined in easeFunctions.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

_onDeserialized.desc: Reads back easeFuncName and the associated function.

work.desc: If the input is not nil/false, writes easeFunc(value) to the output.
